topics.title: Plastic treaty talks stall
topics.summary: International talks on a plastics pollution treaty ended without a deal, leaving countries split over whether to limit plastic production or focus mainly on waste handling.
topics.discussionPrompt: If everyone had to cut plastic use for one week, who would adapt instantly and who would discover their whole routine is wrappers and takeout lids?
sourceNames: Associated Press via The Boston Globe

topics.title: Washington police dispute cools
topics.summary: Washington, D.C. and the Trump administration appeared close to a temporary agreement after a court fight over who controls the city police department.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who would be weirdly good at negotiating office rules, and who would accidentally make a small power struggle ten times more dramatic?
sourceNames: Associated Press via The Boston Globe

topics.title: Robot import ban sparks debate
topics.summary: The U.S. moved to block new foreign-made humanoid robots, robot dogs and power inverters, citing cybersecurity and supply-chain concerns as China leads the market.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would anyone trust a robot coworker on day one, or would they all assign it harmless chores until it proved it wasn't secretly judging them?
sourceNames: Associated Press via San Francisco Chronicle

topics.title: Belgian sewer dig finds gold
topics.summary: A Belgian student working on sewer trenches helped uncover gold coins and bars worth millions hidden in a wall beneath a former brewery owner's villa.
topics.discussionPrompt: If someone found treasure during a boring job, who would call it in calmly and who would immediately start practicing their rich-person laugh?
